description: Milestones 4 and 5: explainable heuristic fall detector with alerts, simulation mode, optional Random Forest training, export, and final documentation. Depends on FEAT-001..FEAT-003.
steps: Create backend/detector.py: FallDetector state machine with configurable FallConfig (in backend/config.py, persisted in data/config.json): spike criterion (motion_score >= spike_threshold, default derived from calibration rapid threshold, and/or rise rate over rise_window_s), post-event stillness criterion (motion score <= stillness_threshold for at least stillness_duration_s, default 3 s) that must start within max_gap_s (default 2 s) after the spike, and a data-quality requirement (no 'unknown' frames over the evaluation window, minimum packet rate). Output FallEvent dataclass with timestamps and a criteria list (name, value, threshold, passed) so the UI can show exactly which criteria triggered. Also a refractory period. Integrate into Engine so the activity class becomes 'potential_fall' while an alert is active. Do not treat low movement alone as a fall; stillness is only evaluated after a spike.

Create backend/alerts.py: AlertManager with states idle -> active (countdown, default 30 s, configurable) -> notified (simulated caregiver notification only: log entry + UI message, no network calls) or cancelled (user cancel). Event log (bounded, persisted append-only to data/events.jsonl) of activity changes, alerts, cancellations, calibrations, recordings, connection events.

Create simulation/__init__.py and simulation/generator.py: SimulationSource implementing LineSource that synthesizes CSI-like data and emits lines in the official classic CSI_DATA format (so they use the same parser) with an unmistakable synthetic marker: use the locally administered MAC 02:51:4d:00:00:00 (never the real TX MAC 1a:00:00:00:00:00) and set Engine source kind 'simulation' + synthetic=True everywhere (snapshot, recordings, calibration, exports). Scenarios: empty_room, walking, sitting, rapid_movement, potential_fall (rapid burst followed by stillness), plus a scripted demo sequence. Model: static multipath per-subcarrier profile + gaussian noise (adjustable noise level) + motion-driven time-varying multipath components (adjustable motion strength, event duration), plausible RSSI and packet rate (~100 Hz). Unit tests only check behavior, not accuracy.

Dashboard (Flask dashboard/server.py + offline vanilla-JS UI in dashboard/static/): extend POST /api/source with {kind:'simulation', scenario, noise, motion_strength, event_duration_s, rate_hz} (validated ranges), add GET /api/alerts, POST /api/alerts/cancel, GET /api/events, POST /api/export and GET /api/exports/<name> (safe filename, served only from data/exports). UI: add Simulation as a source option with scenario selector and sliders (noise, motion strength, event duration, packet rate), with a large persistent 'SIMULATED DATA - synthetic, not evidence of real-world accuracy' banner. Add an 'Alerts' panel: big potential-fall alert card with countdown progress, triggered criteria table, Cancel alert button, simulated caregiver notification message after countdown, event log table. Add 'Export' controls: export current buffer or a session to data/exports/*.csv (amplitudes + features + labels) and download buttons. Visual polish of the dark theme (consistent card styling, colored state badges). Keep the medical disclaimer visible.

Create backend/ml/__init__.py and backend/ml/train_rf.py (CLI: python -m backend.ml.train_rf --recordings data/recordings; scikit-learn/joblib come from optional requirements-ml.txt / make setup-ml, import lazily with a clear message if missing, and keep the module free of flask/pandas imports so it can run in a numpy+scipy+sklearn interpreter): windowed feature extraction reusing backend.processing on replayed takes, labels from take CSVs, GroupKFold / leave-one-session-out splitting by session_id (never random per-packet splits), RandomForestClassifier training, per-class precision/recall/confusion matrix on held-out sessions only, refuses to train if fewer than 2 real sessions or if any session is synthetic unless --allow-synthetic is passed (and then labels outputs as synthetic, not accuracy evidence). Saves model to data/models/ with metadata. Optional: dashboard shows RF prediction alongside heuristic if a model file exists, clearly labeled experimental.

Add a CLI command `python -m backend.cli evaluate --session <dir>` that replays labeled takes through the heuristic detector and reports per-take whether a potential-fall alert fired (for testing the heuristic with recorded examples). Add a Makefile target `simulate` that runs the CLI monitor on the simulation source.

Add tests: tests/test_detector.py (spike followed by stillness triggers with all criteria reported; spike without stillness does not; stillness without prior spike does not; insufficient quality blocks; refractory period; config thresholds respected), tests/test_alerts.py (countdown, cancel, notify, event log persistence in tmp_path), tests/test_simulation.py (lines parse with the official parser, synthetic flag set, potential_fall scenario triggers the detector end-to-end through the Engine, empty_room does not), tests/test_train_rf.py (group split never mixes sessions, refuses synthetic-only data without flag; tiny training run on generated sessions in tmp_path with --allow-synthetic; use pytest.importorskip('sklearn') for the training parts), and Flask test-client tests for the simulation/alerts/export routes in tests/test_dashboard.py.

Finalize README.md: overview, disclaimer, hardware & architecture diagram (text), quick start (make setup or make setup-offline, make dashboard), firmware install/build/flash per target incl. XIAO ESP32-S3, the explicit two-board flashing procedure (identify chip read-only, TX then RX, never the third board), serial troubleshooting, dashboard guide, calibration, recording, replay, fall heuristic explanation and tuning, simulation mode caveats, ML training and session-held-out evaluation, offline operation, optional Raspberry Pi host instructions (same Python app, /dev/ttyACM* or /dev/ttyUSB* ports, dialout group), project structure, and a 'Verification status' section listing what was tested (unit tests, replay, simulation) and what was not (firmware compile, real hardware).
acceptance_criteria: make test passes including detector, alerts, simulation and train_rf tests
In simulation mode the potential_fall scenario triggers a visible alert with a countdown, criteria table and cancel button; empty_room does not trigger
Simulated data is labeled synthetic in UI, recordings metadata and calibration files
python -m backend.ml.train_rf refuses to report accuracy from synthetic or single-session data without explicit flag and uses session-grouped splits
README contains complete macOS setup, flashing, troubleshooting, and verification-status sections
verification: .venv/bin/python -m dashboard --no-browser --port 8599 (background); POST /api/source {kind:'simulation', scenario:'potential_fall'} via curl, poll /api/status until an active alert with criteria appears, POST /api/alerts/cancel, confirm state cancelled; stop server
node --check dashboard/static/app.js and confirm no external URLs in dashboard/static

If scikit-learn is unavailable in .venv (offline), run the RF test with an interpreter that has it, e.g. PYTHONPATH=. /Users/christopherryan/miniconda3/envs/opencv_python/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_train_rf.py if pytest is present there; otherwise record that RF training was not executed
.venv/bin/python -m backend.cli monitor --simulate potential_fall --duration 10 (or the equivalent simulate command) prints frames and a potential-fall event

New tests: test_detector 9, test_alerts 7, test_simulation 9 (incl. parametrized), test_train_rf 9, test_cli 3, test_dashboard +17. compileall backend dashboard simulation OK; node --check app.js OK; no http(s):// in dashboard/static. Server via temp wrapper (.venv/bin/python -m dashboard --no-browser --port 8599): POST /api/source {kind:simulation, scenario:potential_fall} -> /api/status alert.state=active after ~8.5 s with 7 criteria all PASS, activity potential_fall, synthetic true, tx_mac 02:51:4d:00:00:00; POST /api/alerts/cancel -> cancelled, activity back to empty_low; events listed; buffer export + download OK; server terminated. `.venv/bin/python -m backend.cli monitor --simulate potential_fall --duration 10` printed frames and the potential-fall event (+8.1 s) with criteria. RF TRAINING ACTUALLY RAN: PYTHONPATH=. /Users/christopherryan/miniconda3/envs/opencv_python/bin/python (sklearn 1.7.1; pandas/flask/serial/pytest not importable there) with a temp script: 3 generated synthetic sessions -> refused without flag (rc 2); with --allow-synthetic 3 grouped folds, report, rf_*_synthetic.joblib/.json saved in a temp dir and reloaded. Node smoke harness ran app.js against real API payloads (active alert): title, countdown, 7 criteria rows, events and banner rendered without errors. Temp scripts, data/events.jsonl, data/config.json and exports deleted. NOT verified: browser rendering, firmware, real hardware, heuristic on real CSI.

New modules/API: backend/config.py FallConfig(enabled, spike_threshold=0 (=thresholds.rapid), rise_window_s=1.5, min_rise_fraction=0.5, stillness_threshold=0 (=thresholds.low), stillness_duration_s=3, max_gap_s=2, min_packet_rate_hz=20, refractory_s=30) and AlertConfig(countdown_s=30, event_log_max=500, activity_min_s=1) as AppConfig.fall/.alerts. backend/detector.py FallDetector(cfg).update(frame, thresholds)->FallEvent|None (criteria motion_spike, sudden_rise, stillness_onset, stillness_level, stillness_duration, data_quality, packet_rate), status(), effective_thresholds(). backend/alerts.py EventLog(path|None, maxlen).add(kind, message, /, level=, **data) (JSONL append, 5 MB rotation to .1, reloads tail), AlertManager states idle/active/notified/cancelled, simulated notification text only (no I/O). backend/monitor.py FallMonitor(engine, event_log) registers frame hook + status providers 'alert'/'detector', sets the Engine activity override while an alert is unresolved, logs debounced activity, calibration and connection events. Engine additions: add_status_provider, set_activity_override/activity_override (snapshot and stored frame activity use the override; hooks get the classified activity), buffer_packets(), frames(). backend/offline.py OfflineReplay(path, config, calibration) yields Step(packet, frame, activity, label, take_id, session_id). backend/export.py export_buffer/export_session/list_exports/validate_export_name. backend/ml/train_rf.py (load_dataset, apply_policy, group_kfold, confusion_and_scores, evaluate_grouped, main; --allow-synthetic, --exclude-synthetic, --no-save; a session counts as synthetic if session.json says so or packets use the simulator MAC). simulation/generator.py SimParams/SimulationSource(params, realtime=True, duration_s, t0)/CSISimulator/SCENARIOS/PARAM_RANGES/SIM_MAC; scenarios empty_room, walking, sitting, rapid_movement, potential_fall, demo; status.extra label/label_name = current phase + ' [simulated]'. CLI: monitor gained --simulate/--noise/--motion-strength/--event-duration/--rate/--seed/--config plus motion/detector output and event printing; new `evaluate --session <dir|take> [--calibration] [--json]`. Server: create_app(..., config_path=None); routes GET /api/simulation, GET /api/alerts, POST /api/alerts/cancel, GET/POST /api/detector/config (saved to config_path with base, not calibrated, thresholds), GET /api/events, POST /api/export, GET /api/exports, GET /api/exports/<name>. dashboard __main__ --simulate SCENARIO. RecordingManager.on_event callback (session/take events). Makefile: simulate (SCENARIO=demo DURATION=0), dashboard-sim, evaluate SESSION=, train-rf. UI: Simulation tab with 4 sliders; alerts card (countdown progress, criteria table, Cancel/Dismiss, notification text, detector state, settings form, event log); Export card; motion chart adds a stillness line.

Deviations / notes: the test case {kind:'simulation'} -> 400 in test_dashboard was replaced by invalid-simulation cases (simulation is now valid). The optional dashboard RF prediction display was NOT implemented (no sklearn in .venv); README says the model is not used by the dashboard. Simulator levels (uncalibrated thresholds): empty ~0.55, walking ~3.2, rapid ~7, fall burst peak ~8-10, lying still ~0.6; noise 0.1 lifts stillness to ~1.56, so no alert fires (shows why calibration is needed). The alert countdown uses the wall clock; the detector uses data time. README rewritten in full (disclaimer, statement that hardware/firmware were not verified, Flask-instead-of-Streamlit reason, no-auth note, two-board flashing, Raspberry Pi, Verification status). .gitignore adds data/events.jsonl.1.
